beats.label: hook
beats.text: 467,000 players jumped in on day one — and the ship AI stranded every single one of them on an alien ocean planet.

beats.label: gameplay
beats.text: You dive into bioluminescent alien biomes, harvest resources from the deep, build underwater bases, and crew submarines — all while something below keeps getting bigger.

beats.label: standout
beats.text: Subnautica 2 is the first in the series with 4-player co-op, built on Unreal Engine 5 — the ocean has never looked this terrifyingly alive.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: Early Access is live right now — $29.99 on Steam and Xbox Series X|S. Wishlist or dive in today.
